summary_1line: Valmiki entrusts Sita to female ascetics and the text closes with traditional benedictory verses praising Rama and wishing prosperity and justice.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sage Valmiki gently entrusts a sorrowful Sita to a group of female ascetics in the forest hermitage.
Valmiki walks back to his forest hermitage surrounded by disciples after placing Sita under the ascetics' care.
